name: Dont render all messages
description:
## Conversation Summary

1. **Request:** Stop rendering every `ChatEntry` in `ChatMessageList.vue` — mount messages only when visible, keep a skeleton reserving measured height, preserve `ChatMiniMap` accuracy, and unload off-screen messages after ~30 s.
2. **Constraint discovered:** The wrapper div must stay in the DOM for every message (mini-map needs a 1:1 `messageRefs[i]` ↔ `messages[i]` mapping and correct scroll height); only the child content becomes conditional.
3. **Solution delivered:** `IntersectionObserver` (`root` = scroll container, `rootMargin: 600px`) for visibility, `ResizeObserver` + height cache (`measuredHeights`) for placeholder sizing, `hiddenAt` timestamps with a 2 s sweeper that unmounts after `unloadDelay = 30000` ms, and `keepViewportStable()` to prevent scroll jumps on first real measurement.
4. **Pinning rules:** Never unload messages that are streaming (`!done`), being edited, have inline events open, or are the events-drawer target; last 10 messages + streaming ones are primed on mount/chat switch.
5. **Follow-up:** Generated the full `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` with `loadActiveBranch()` removed from `created()` (still called by `togglePRView()`) to avoid one `repo.info()` request per remount.

messages.content: Dont render all messages only when they become visible. Render a skeleton to reserve the space and keep chatminimap working but only render when visible, and even consider unloading them when unvisible for at least 30 secs or so.

## 1. Review & Understand the Task **Objective** - Stop mounting every `ChatEntry` in `ChatMessageList`; mount one only when it is (or is about to be) inside the messages viewport. - Keep a **skeleton placeholder** in the DOM for unmounted messages so the scroll height is preserved (no layout jump, minimap stays accurate). - Keep `ChatMiniMap` working: its `messageRefs[i]` must stay 1:1 with `messages[i]` → **the wrapper div must always exist**, only its *content* is conditional. - **Unload** a message that has been off-screen for ≥ 30 s (drops markdown/highlight/code viewers/observers). **Constraints found in the code** - `ChatMiniMap.recalculate()` reads `el.getBoundingClientRect()` per entry → the wrapper (not the child) has to stay in the DOM and must keep its height → we cache the measured height and use it for the placeholder. - `ChatEntry` is keyed by `message.doc_id` and gets a stable object from `Chat.vue#stableMessages`, so keying lazy state by `doc_id` is safe. - `ChatEntry.created()` calls `repository.info()` (`loadActiveBranch`) for **every** mount — with lazy rendering this would become an API request per remount, so it must move out (it is already loaded by `togglePRView()`). ## 2. Change Proposal | Concern | Solution | |---|---| | Visible detection | One `IntersectionObserver` with `root = scrollContainer` and `rootMargin: 600px 0px` (pre-render band, so scrolling feels seamless) | | Space reservation | One `ResizeObserver` caches each wrapper's real height (`measuredHeights[doc_id]`); placeholder uses it (fallback `estimatedHeight = 96px`) | | Unloading | Off-screen timestamps (`hiddenAt`) + a 2 s sweeper that unmounts after `unloadDelay = 30000` ms | | Never unload | Streaming (`!done`), the message being edited, inline events panel open, events drawer target | | Scroll stability | First real measurement replaces the estimate → compensate `scrollTop` if the message is above the viewport, or re-pin to bottom when `autoScroll` | | MiniMap | Untouched — wrapper divs keep 1:1 index alignment and reserved height | | Remount cost | `ChatEntry` no longer fetches `repo.info()` on every mount | ## 3. Changes Summary | File | Change | |---|---| | `src/components/chat/ChatMessageList.vue` | Wrapper ref now also carries the message; `ChatEntry` becomes conditional; added static skeleton placeholder with reserved height; added IO/RO based visibility + height caching + 30 s unload sweeper + first-render scroll compensation; chat switch resets lazy state | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | `loadActiveBranch()` removed from `created()` (kept in `togglePRView()`), avoiding one `repo.info()` request per (re)mount | ## 4. The Changes created() { this.loadThreadChat() // `activeBranch` is only consumed by the Review (PR) view and is loaded by // `togglePRView()`. Loading it here fired one `repo.info()` request per // rendered entry — entries are now mounted/unmounted while scrolling. this.collapsed = this.displayMessage.hide }, ## 5. Anti-Patterns Avoided - ❌ **`rootMargin` with `root: null`** — the scroll container clips its children, so a "just below the fold" message never intersects the viewport rectangle. The observer is rooted at `scrollContainer` so the 600px band actually works. - ❌ **Removing the wrapper div** for unmounted messages — that would break `ChatMiniMap` (`messageRefs[i]` ↔ `messages[i]`) and collapse the scroll height. Only the *content* is conditional. - ❌ **Unloading freshly measured content** — height is cached (`ResizeObserver` + cache-on-unload) *before* unmount, otherwise skeletons would drift from the real content. - ❌ **Animated shimmer on every placeholder** — hundreds of concurrent CSS animations during scrolling; placeholders are static. ## 6. Accessibility Checklist - [x] Placeholders are `aria-hidden="true"` — screen readers never announce ghost content. - [x] Unmounted messages have no focusable descendants, so Tab order never lands on a hidden message. - [x] No new color-only information (placeholder uses the existing muted surface tokens). - [x] Streaming/edited/expanded messages stay mounted → keyboard focus and live regions are never destroyed mid-interaction. ## 7. Implementation Steps 1. `ChatMessageList`: add lazy state (`renderedKeys`, `hiddenAt`, `measuredHeights`, thresholds). 2. Pass `message` into `setMessageRef(el, ix, message)` and register/unregister the wrapper with both observers. 3. Swap `ChatEntry` for `v-if="shouldRenderMessage(message)"` + `v-else` placeholder sized by `placeholderHeight()`. 4. Create the `IntersectionObserver` (`root: scrollContainer`, `rootMargin: 600px`) and `ResizeObserver` in `mounted`; disconnect in `beforeUnmount`. 5. Add the 30 s sweeper (`startUnloadTimer` / `sweepHiddenMessages`) that caches the height then unmounts. 6. Add first-render scroll compensation (`keepViewportStable`) and re-pin when `autoScroll` is true. 7. Prime the last 10 messages + streaming ones on mount and on chat switch. 8. `ChatEntry`: drop `loadActiveBranch()` from `created()` (kept in `togglePRView()`).

history.summary:
## Summary

- **Request:** Render chat messages lazily instead of mounting all of them, keeping skeletons that reserve space and preserve `ChatMiniMap` alignment, plus unloading off-screen messages after ~30 s.
- **Approach:** One `IntersectionObserver` (rooted at the scroll container, 600px `rootMargin`) drives mounting; wrapper divs always stay in the DOM so `messageRefs[i]` ↔ `messages[i]` stays 1:1 for the minimap.
- **Space reservation:** A `ResizeObserver` caches each message's measured height in `measuredHeights[doc_id]`, used by the static skeleton (`estimatedHeight` 96px fallback); heights are cached before unmount to avoid scroll jumps.
- **Unloading:** `hiddenAt` timestamps + a 2 s sweeper unmount messages hidden ≥ 30 s, while streaming, editing, inline-events-open, or drawer-target messages are pinned and never unloaded.
- **Files changed:** `src/components/chat/ChatMessageList.vue` (lazy state, observers, placeholder, sweeper, scroll compensation, chat-switch reset) and `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` (`loadActiveBranch()` removed from `created()` to avoid one `repo.info()` call per remount).
